message.content: Based on the conversation provided in the sources, there is no mention of Li Hua specifically requesting to move the Thursday class to Friday after initially suggesting a change to Friday. In Source 1, it is noted that Li Hua initially asked Jennifer to reschedule their training session from Thursday to Friday due to an unexpected work meeting, and Jennifer agreed to this change. There is no further communication indicating that Li Hua subsequently requested to change the Friday class to another day. Therefore, the information does not support the claim that Li Hua sent a message to Jennifer asking to turn the Thursday class to Friday after changing the training session from Thursday to Friday.
